::::{#exm-local-constant}
#### A tricube-weighted average

Take the target point $x_0 = 0$
and a local neighborhood of five observations
whose farthest member lies at distance 1 from $x_0$,
so the scaled distances are $u_i = x_i - x_0 = x_i$:

| $x_i$ | $y_i$ | $w_i = K(u_i) = (1 - \abs{u_i}^3)^3$ |
|---|---|---|
| $-1$ | 10 | $(1 - 1)^3 = 0$ |
| $-0.5$ | 2 | $(1 - 0.125)^3 \approx 0.6699$ |
| $0$ | 3 | $(1 - 0)^3 = 1$ |
| $0.5$ | 7 | $(1 - 0.125)^3 \approx 0.6699$ |
| $1$ | 10 | $(1 - 1)^3 = 0$ |

By @thm-local-constant:

$$
\ba
\est{f}(0)
&= \frac{0 \cdot 10 + 0.6699 \cdot 2 + 1 \cdot 3 + 0.6699 \cdot 7 + 0 \cdot 10}
{0 + 0.6699 + 1 + 0.6699 + 0}
&& \text{(substitute the table)}
\\ &\approx \frac{1.3398 + 3 + 4.6895}{0.6699 + 1 + 0.6699}
&& \text{(multiply, and drop the zero terms)}
\\ &= \frac{9.0293}{2.3398}
&& \text{(add)}
\\ &\approx 3.859
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$

The two observations at distance 1 get zero weight,
so the large outcomes $y = 10$ at $x = \pm 1$ do not affect the fit,
and the closer observation at $x = 0$ counts more than those at $x = \pm 0.5$.
The unweighted sample mean of all five outcomes would be $32/5 = 6.4$.
::::
